Create a hyper-dramatic, Pixar-style 3D animated football sequence inside a colossal glowing futuristic stadium. The atmosphere should feel mythic, emotional, and operatic, with heavy crowd noise, chants, and rising stadium roar throughout key moments.
🎬 CUT SCENE TIMELINE (FOLLOW EXACTLY)

0.0s – 1.0s | “Instant Stadium Establishment”

Ultra-fast aerial shot of a massive storm-lit futuristic stadium. Lightning flashes reveal roaring crowds. Immediate camera zoom toward the pitch—no delay.
1.0s – 4.0s | “Hero Focus Entrance”
Cat #16 enters the pitch in slow motion. Camera stays tight on face and eyes only—focused, calm, determined. Jersey flutters in wind. Crowd chants grow louder.

4.0s – 7.0s | “Impossible Pressure Trap”

Opposing defenders surround the Cat in a tight press. Space collapses. Ground subtly cracks under tension. Ball control becomes extremely difficult.
7.0s – 10.0s | “Signature Aerial Breakthrough Move”

Cat #16 executes a gravity-defying backflip dribble signature move, controlling the ball mid-air. Inspired CR7-style athletic flair combined with acrobatic spin.

Camera rotates dynamically around the action with glowing motion trails.
10.0s – 12.5s | “Final Impossible Shot Setup”

Mid-air recovery into strike stance. Slow motion begins. Close-up on eyes locking toward goal. Stadium sound briefly dips, then rebuilds tension.

12.5s – 14.3s | “Legendary Goal Strike”
Explosive cinematic kick. Ball shoots like a glowing comet, curving violently into the top corner. Net ripples dramatically. Crowd erupts at maximum volume.

14.3s – 15.0s | “Siuuu Celebration Finish”
Cat #16 performs a Cristiano Ronaldo-style “Siuuu” jump celebration, arms wide. Ends with a confident wink at camera. Fireworks explode behind silhouette.
